New in round 4; round 3 ran no container. Departure w12a-1 (lane w12a-env-allowlist, ruling docs-1, glitch-2f's assignment, Tue 13 Oct 2026; no transfer): the take environment is an ALLOWLIST. TAKE_ENV is the one table (per arm: PATH, HOME at the config mount, LANG, the run tree's TMPDIR, TMP and TEMP, the proxy, the harness's own switches and config home, and the one credential by NAME); LOGIN_VARIABLE and HARNESS_ENV are views derived from it. take_environment builds the agent's whole starting environment from the row alone; exec_values is it less the credential; exec_argv runs every turn under LAUNCHER (the image's python3, -I -S, which execs the harness with exactly the row's pairs and the credential read by name), its client environment the runtime's needs and the credential alone (the values no longer ride as -e NAME=VALUE). refuse_env_files (with env_file_dirs) refuses, by path, a .env or .gemini/.env in the working folder, any parent up to the run tree, and HOME's host side (the config folder): at launch before any runtime call, and at every run_turn before its exec. check_model refuses a short Gemini CLI alias by name (MODEL_PINS: arm G's full ids, the v0.63.0 alias table). The closed refusal lists, PENDING values and every other function are unchanged. Bound by tests/test_env_allowlist.py E1-E4 and G1. Recovery addendum (13 Oct 2026): the launcher also refuses .env and .gemini/.env by name in the actual container cwd, every ancestor through slash, and current HOME immediately before each harness exec; host-side scans are early checks only. The adapter flags and their long forms are parsed by consuming values; compact clusters and positional tails refuse.
